quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2025 (02-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (December 1, 2024 - November 30, 2025) results: net sales JPY 36,265,691 thousand, up 10.9%; operating profit JPY 6,187 million, up 34.2%, with the operating margin at 17.1% (14.1% a year earlier); ordinary profit JPY 6,557 million, up 37.9%; profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 6,887,536 thousand, up 70.3%. Management attributes the sales growth to recovering sales in the Chemicals and Electronic Materials businesses and steady sales in Functional Chemicals. Extraordinary income included JPY 3,140 million of subsidy received under the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry's domestic investment promotion subsidy for supply-chain measures.

quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2025 (02-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's strategy under P&D 2030: accelerate development of leading-edge semiconductor materials and expand into peripheral materials to grow the semiconductor business; apply its LCD resist design technology to non-display uses; extend hydrophilic polymer technology to biocompatible and new electronic materials; work with other institutions and makers on organic piezoelectric and stretchable elastomer materials; develop biomass acrylates and acrylic acid from non-fossil raw materials; and strengthen overseas sales with sales companies in China, Korea and North America and a channel strategy that includes local production. After the Korean subsidiary set up in 2024, it established a joint venture in North America in 2025. Management expects the outlook to stay uncertain because of a possible overseas slowdown centred on China, higher fuel and raw-material prices, geopolitical risks and the effects of prolonged Japan-China tension.

quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry annual securities report: FY2025 (02-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 R&D expenses were JPY 1,898 million, 5.2% of net sales. Electronic Materials: focused on developing leading-edge semiconductor materials typified by EUV resist monomers, with manufacturing-technology development in parallel to meet customers' tightening quality requirements; a mid-scale laboratory was completed in the year to allow faster scale-up; drawing on its photoresist technology it is proposing negative resist materials for lift-off processes and positive resist materials for wiring formation outside display materials. Chemicals: new monomers with high refractive index, high adhesion and low dielectric properties, and non-fossil-derived monomers. Functional Chemicals: a new foundation material that prevents makeup breakdown and the one-component super-hydrophilic coating MIRROBIC. New business: elastomers, stretchable conductive materials, light-control materials and organic piezoelectric materials based on specialty acrylics; proposals of new monomers including a liquid bismaleimide resin and the high-Tg monomer Viscoat MBL, and catechol monomers with strong adhesion.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expenses JPY 1,898 million, 5.2% of net sales
